title: The first clearing
caption: A single flat hex, a handful of houses and scattered trees. The ranch begins as a small diorama with simple lighting choices.

title: Finding the visual language
caption: Cream controls, teal roofs and soft green trees establish the palette. Large preset buttons and sliders still occupy much of the screen.

title: A place with a purpose
caption: Fenced pens, animals, a garden and branching paths turn the clearing into a recognizable working farm.

title: Beyond one hex
caption: The footprint expands into connected hexes. This zigzag capture shows the early terrain presentation, still largely flat and uniformly planted.

title: The landscape changes season
caption: Snow and bare trees transform the same family of generated spaces. The configuration panel exposes the winter setting.

title: A broader farm palette
caption: More varied planting and farm structures fill a branching board. Icon controls replace the wide text presets.

title: The ranch after dark
caption: Warm building lights stand out against a cold, snowy landscape. Night becomes a visibly different atmosphere.

title: Time becomes part of the interface
caption: A named ranch, day counter, speed and season share the toolbar. Autumn color gives the connected tiles a different character.

title: Light gives the scene depth
caption: Long shadows connect trees and buildings to the ground. The toolbar has become compact enough to leave more room for the ranch.

title: Weather enters the scene
caption: Cloud forms and muted light introduce another layer of atmosphere over the dense planting and farm paths.

title: Laurel Orchard Ranch
caption: Your latest production screenshot: one broad ranch tile, connected pens and garden, a playground, mixed vegetation, long shadows and the compact weather controls.
